children: PB Fintech co-founder Alok Bansal will step down as Executive Vice Chairman and Whole Time Director on March 31, 2027. He will continue to serve on the company’s board as a Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director from April 1, 2027, as per a media report.

The company’s board approved the change in Bansal’s designation at a meeting held on November 18, 2026. According to a regulatory filing, Bansal expressed his desire to step back from day-to-day executive responsibilities for personal reasons.

Bansal co-founded Policybazaar with Yashish Dahiya in 2008. During his 18-year association with the company, he has played a key role in its strategy, fundraising, corporate development and investor relations, including its public listing in 2021.

PB Fintech reported a 43 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 193 crore in Q2 FY27, compared to Rs 135 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. Revenue from operations grew 35 per cent to Rs 2,178 crore from Rs 1,614 crore in Q2 FY26.

Commenting on the development, PB Fintech Chairman and CEO Yashish Dahiya said Bansal had communicated his intention to step back five years ago. He added that Bansal would continue to support the company in his capacity as a board member.
PB Fintech is the parent company of Policybazaar, an online insurance marketplace, and Paisabazaar, a consumer credit marketplace.
